environment.description: EKS pod in cluster 'prod-eu-west-1' with identical code. Node group launched with instance metadata options: HttpEndpoint=enabled, HttpTokens=required (IMDSv2), HttpPutResponseHopLimit=1. Pod runs with a projected service account token (IRSA) but the IAM role has no IMDS-related permissions. Additionally, a Cilium L3/L4 CiliumNetworkPolicy is applied to the namespace 'enrichment-services' with an egress rule that only permits TCP connections to endpoints matching the label 'app=cloudfront-origin' on port 443, and a CIDR-based egress allowance limited to the CloudFront IP prefix list (com.amazonaws.global.cloudfront.origin-facing). The policy has a default-deny egress posture for all other traffic including link-local 169.254.0.0/16. The pod's container also runs with a seccomp profile (RuntimeDefault) though this does not directly affect network calls.
